item.title: The evaluation script breaks on Python 3.14 (3.13 still supported)
item.body:

```
_pickle.PicklingError: Can't pickle local object <function check_correctness.<locals>.unsafe_execute at 0x7f5186ab87d0>
when serializing dict item '_target'
when serializing multiprocessing.context.Process state
when serializing multiprocessing.context.Process object
```
